interval: paired percentile bootstrap, conditional on the frozen maps
legal: per query: seed-averaged transformed nDCG@10 minus Raw; queries resampled with one draw per distinct query-id set (AILACasedocs and AILAStatutes share one), reused for every method; task means averaged with equal weight on each resample
sts: sentence pairs resampled (one draw, rng seed bootstrap_seed + 1, reused for every method and seed); Spearman recomputed per seed on each resample, averaged over seeds, minus the Raw resample Spearman
maps: fitted on each donor's ID training split (revised.run_id), seeds 0-2, frozen; not refit
